_comment: 1800-1929 Mayan-language and Maya-people books (#6559, job maya-modern-6559). Each candidate was run through scripts/import/check-holdings.ts by IA URL AND by title (2026-10-15).

Not imported, already held: libraryofaborigi03brinuoft (Gueguence; held as gegencecomed00brinrich, 6acc39a7c1411f8cc628d038), libraryofaborigi08brinuoft (Rig Veda Americanus; held as rigvedaamericanu00brin, 6acc3999c1411f8cc628ce54), relationdeschos00landgoog (Landa/Brasseur 1864; held visible as 69f8c0f74c6a515115aedadd and 69ee93b9f2c6312502f6a526, plus hidden 6a09ff6efa20006dbaba949c).

Imported as other editions of held books: the 1910 and 1928 U molcabthanil camathan (Merida printings by different presses; the 1905 Loteria printing is held as umolcabthanilcam00belt, 6acc3e9f230e9a56175ce699) and the 1912 Beltran Declaracion (the 1860 Espinosa reprint is held as declaracindelad00beltgoog, 6acc3df2230e9a56175cdd1c).

Run: node scripts/import/new-world-wave.mjs --list scripts/import/maya-modern-6559.json --commit, then hold every inserted id with scripts/maintenance/hold-pipeline-books.mjs --reason maya-modern-6559 --issue 6559 so no paid OCR lane reads them; they go to the Opus lane (maya-ref-opus-6559's recipe).
Decipherment studies (Thomas, Morley, Gates, Spinden, Tozzer, Gunckel) belong to #5653 and are not in this list.

books.title: Quilich xocbil u payalchi ti c-colebil x-zuhuy Maria: yetel u chucaan payalchi or ualkezahantacob ti Maya-dtan
books.author: Anonymous
books.note: 1880, Merida (Spinosa). Yucatec Marian rosary and prayers, 31 p. IA newberry (Ayer).

books.title: U molcabthanil camathan = Catecismo de la doctrina cristiana
books.author: Pedro Beltrán de Santa Rosa
books.note: 1910, Merida (Tipografia y Litografia Moderna), 46 p. Other edition of the held 1905 printing (umolcabthanilcam00belt). IA newberry (Ayer).

books.title: U molcabthanil camathan = Catecismo de la doctrina cristiana
books.author: Pedro Beltrán de Santa Rosa
books.note: 1928, Merida (Imprenta Cecilio Leal), 46 p. Other edition of the held 1905 printing. IA newberry (Ayer).

books.title: Declaración de la doctrina cristiana en el idioma yucateco
books.author: Pedro Beltrán de Santa Rosa
books.note: 1912, Merida (Imprenta de la Loteria del Estado), 39 p. Other edition of the held 1860 reprint (declaracindelad00beltgoog). IA newberry (Ayer).

books.title: Quicheísmos: contribución al estudio del folklore americano
books.author: Santiago Ignacio Barberena
books.note: 1894, San Salvador. K'iche' loanwords and folklore in Salvadoran Spanish. IA newberry (Ayer).

books.title: Los mayas primitivos: algunos estudios sobre su origen, idioma y costumbres
books.author: Manuel Rejón García
books.note: 1905, Merida. Yucatecan study of Maya origin, language and customs by the author of the Maya-dialect folk tales.

books.title: Toponimia maya-hispano-nahoa
books.author: Cecilio Agustín Robelo
books.note: 1902, Cuernavaca. Place-name dictionary of Maya and Nahuatl toponyms. IA newberry (Ayer).

books.title: Mélanges de philologie et de paléographie américaines
books.author: Hyacinthe de Charencey
books.note: 1883, Paris. Charencey's essays on Maya-Quiche philology and the Maya calendar and script. IA Google scan.
